entries.04870a676a963e7e: A steel trading company and manufacturer headquartered in Chuo-ku, Osaka, where the company and nine subsidiaries form a group. The reportable segments are four: the Trading Division, the Sheet Metal Processed Products Division, Overseas Business and the Hardened Steel Strip Division, and consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 727.
entries.0e622636416c1e69: Under its management policy of 'Respecting people and growing together as a company,' its medium-term management plan (fiscal years ended March 2027 to March 2030) states that it will advance a transformation of its business mix, gradually reducing its reliance on internal combustion engine-related parts and using growth pillars of expanding sales of high value-added products, expanding into 6 key fields (glove processing, precision processing, non-ferrous processing, drawing processing, plate forging processing and joining processing), strengthening EV-related business, and reducing inventory through DX. It sets the goals of substantially expanding sales of high value-added products over 4 years through deeper relationships with existing customers and new customer development, and of shortening inventory turnover periods by March 2030 through DX.

entries.5f77cfc34b0ebafe: Within the same group, it sells as a specialist trader of special strip steel and manufactures quenched steel strip and sheet metal products made mainly from special strip steel. Its strength lies in processing technology based on deep knowledge of the characteristics of special strip steel, and it supplies products to a broad range of markets, including automotive engines and transmissions, agricultural machinery and housing-related equipment. In 1966 it succeeded in industrial mass production of bainite steel strip.
entries.61f38bf3bdae18a8: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥48,192 million, down 4.6% from the previous consolidated fiscal year. The MD&A explains that the Trading Division recorded lower revenue as adjustments continued in demand from its main customers in automobiles and home appliances, while the Quenched Steel Strip Division, Sheet Metal Products Division and Overseas Division recorded higher revenue. The Sheet Metal Products Division saw firm demand for agricultural machinery, and expanded orders for new parts are said to have contributed to the Overseas Division.
